source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Próprio * Fílio suo non pepércit Deus, sed pro nobis ómnibus trádidit illum.
text.en: God spared not His Own Son * but delivered Him up for us all.

text.la: Anxiátus est super me * spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.
text.en: My spirit is overwhelmed within me; * my heart within me is troubled.

text.la: Ait latro ad latrónem: * Nos quidem digna factis recípimus, hic autem quid fecit? Meménto mei, Dómine, dum véneris in regnum tuum.
text.en: One thief said unto the other: * We indeed receive the due reward of our deeds, but what hath this man done? Lord, remember me, when thou comest into thy kingdom.

text.la: Cum conturbáta fúerit * ánima mea, Dómine, misericórdiæ memor eris.
text.en: Lord, when my soul is troubled, * thou wilt remember mercy.

text.la: Meménto mei, * Dómine, dum véneris in regnum tuum.
text.en: Lord, remember me * when thou comest into thy kingdom.

text.la: Posuérunt * super caput eius causam ipsíus scriptam: Iesus Nazarénus, Rex Iudæórum.
text.en: They set up over his head his accusation written: * Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.

office.title: Feria Sexta in Passione et Morte Domini
